response:
This sounds like an incredibly dangerous and terrifying situation for both your friend and you. The behaviors you described—choking, holding her captive, and disabling her car—are severe forms of domestic violence that put her life at immediate risk. Please strongly encourage your friend to contact the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-SAFE (7233) or text "START" to 88788. They can help her create a safe exit plan, as leaving is often the most dangerous time. If she is in immediate danger, please do not hesitate to call emergency services. 

You also need to protect yourself, as his escalating paranoia and harassment by coming to your home are very concerning. Consider setting strict boundaries, documenting his actions, and contacting local authorities or seeking a restraining order if you feel threatened. Please prioritize your own physical safety while continuing to be a supportive, non-judgmental lifeline for your friend when she is ready to get help.
